note: dxpr_builder_page is a config-only submodule of dxpr_builder. It installs the node type drag_and_drop_page whose body view-display component uses the dxpr_builder_text formatter, plus three DXPR theme-helper fields (field_dth_page_layout, field_dth_main_content_width, field_dth_hide_regions). No settings, permissions, schema, or Drush; its only PHP is a ModuleUninstallValidator that blocks uninstall while drag_and_drop_page nodes exist. Cases are grounded in that shipped config and content type: introspection reads the body formatter on node.drag_and_drop_page.default; execution creates a drag_and_drop_page node, verified live.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal dxpr_builder_page submodule add when enabled?
evals.expected_output: It installs a ready-made content type 'Drag and drop Page' (machine name drag_and_drop_page) whose body field is displayed/edited with the DXPR Builder (dxpr_builder_text) formatter, plus three DXPR theme-helper layout fields. It is config-only (no settings of its own).

evals.prompt: Besides the body, which extra fields does the dxpr_builder_page content type provide and what are they for?
evals.expected_output: Three DXPR theme-helper fields: field_dth_page_layout (page layout), field_dth_main_content_width (main content width), and field_dth_hide_regions (which theme regions to hide on the page).

evals.prompt: Why might Drupal refuse to uninstall the dxpr_builder_page module, and how do I resolve it?
evals.expected_output: Its DXPRBuilderPageUninstallValidator blocks uninstall while any drag_and_drop_page nodes still exist (to protect content). Delete all drag_and_drop_page nodes first, then uninstall.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the default view display of the drag_and_drop_page content type and state which formatter its body field uses.
evals.expected_output: The body component in core.entity_view_display.node.drag_and_drop_page.default uses the dxpr_builder_text formatter (DXPR Builder).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a new node of the DXPR Builder 'Drag and drop Page' content type (machine name drag_and_drop_page). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: At least one node of type drag_and_drop_page exists, e.g. Node::create(['type'=>'drag_and_drop_page','title'=>'...'])->save();.
